fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary on Dade County and Miami municipal elections and anticipated changes in city leadership; reporting and satire related to Tallahassee legislative activity; extensive coverage of Prohibition-era enforcement and federal court proceedings; Miami Beach civic regulation and tourism-related disputes (including causeway access and bathing-suit controversy); entertainment and nightlife notices (including Jimmy Hodges' Follies); and business/real-estate promotional content, including Coral Gables building activity.
